title: A Thorn for the Crown
author: Marguerite Underhill
blurb: Ulyana Okonkwo, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
